test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If a sum of money amounts to 6 times of itself in 25 years at simple interest, then what is the rate of interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Time = 25 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = PRT/100

Amount = Simple Interest + sum

**Calculation:**

Let us assume the sum is P

So the Amount will be 6P 

then Simple interest = 6P - P

Simple interest = 5P

Simple Interest = PRT/100

5P = (P × R × 25)/100

⇒ 5 = R/4

⇒ R = 20%

**∴ The rate of interest per annum will be 20%.**
